worldcombat.skill.block.summary: Spreads its arms and raises an arc of iron barricade on the far side of the target, sealing its retreat: the wall shoves the target toward the user and pins it briefly, then keeps it penned between the wall and the user. The wall is short, can be jumped over or mined, and folds away when its time runs out.
worldcombat.skill.block.use.0: Cut off a fleeing target for allies to finish
worldcombat.skill.block.use.1: Bar a doorway or a lane
worldcombat.skill.block.use.2: Press a charging thick target back into melee
worldcombat.skill.block.description.0: Raises a barricade about %1$s blocks wide and %2$s blocks tall on the target's far side, about %3$s blocks away.
worldcombat.skill.block.description.1: The barricade and the press last about %1$s; the slam roots the target in place for %2$s (it cannot move but can still act) and shoves it %3$s blocks toward the user.
worldcombat.skill.block.description.2: The wall is built from about %1$s columns across %2$s degrees.
worldcombat.skill.block.option.on: Braced: wall height +1 block and press duration about x1.35, at the cost of a narrower arc (about x0.75), wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +12 ticks - taller and longer, but slower and narrower.
worldcombat.skill.block.option.off: Open-armed: a wider arc (about x1.15), a faster cast and a shorter cooldown, at the cost of one block of height and a shorter press.
worldcombat.skill.block.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, spends %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.block.growth.0: At level %1$s the press rises to %2$s and the cooldown falls to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.block.preference.brace: On: wall height +1 block and press duration about x1.35, at the cost of a narrower arc (about x0.75), wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +12 ticks - locking one fleeing thick target into a narrow lane. Off (open-armed): a wider arc (about x1.15), a faster cast and a shorter cooldown, at the cost of one block of height and a shorter press - barring a retreat across open ground.
worldcombat.skill.block.preference.ai.ma: The companion only walls off a threat within this distance; lower keeps it close, higher lets it cut the retreat from farther out.
worldcombat.skill.block.preference.ai.ca: On: a fleeing target scores one tier higher - a wall on its far side; off: ranked as an ordinary control move. An already trapped target is never walled again.
worldcombat.skill.block.preference.ai.le: When on, the companion may leave its post to wall off a threat even under a hold order.
worldcombat.skill.block.description.pres: While pressed, the target moves about 45%% slower; getting past the iron bars means going around, over them or mining through, and the barricade folds away when the press ends.
